description: Build a Wi-Fi network payload (WIFI:T:WPA;S:...;P:...;;) that phones join when scanned: WPA/WPA2 (and WPA2/WPA3 transition) networks, WPA3-only (T:SAE), WEP or open ones. WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise networks (T:WPA2-EAP with the EAP method and identity) are read by ZXing-based scanner apps, not by phone camera apps. Pass the result as `data` to generate_qr_code.

anonymousIdentity.description: WPA2-EAP: anonymous (outer) identity, if the network uses one

eapMethod.description: WPA2-EAP: EAP method, PEAP (default), TTLS or PWD

hidden.description: True when the network does not broadcast its SSID

password.description: Network password. Leave out for open networks.

phase2.description: WPA2-EAP with PEAP or TTLS: inner authentication, MSCHAPV2 (default), GTC, PAP or MSCHAP

security.description: WPA covers WPA and WPA2 personal networks and WPA2/WPA3 transition networks (every phone joins those); SAE is a WPA3-only network; WPA2-EAP is WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise (802.1X), which phone camera apps don't join (only ZXing-based scanner apps read it); nopass is an open network

name: qr_payload_wifi
title: Wi-Fi QR payload
